## SnapSense 0.1.4

- Choose Groq, OpenAI, or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint in the app. Load available models from the provider or enter a model ID directly.
- Use a local endpoint without an API key, or save a separate key for each provider through the operating system's encrypted storage.
- Updated the default Groq vision model and removed the shared key from public installers. Groq and OpenAI users should enter their own key in model settings.
- Improved capture selection, follow-up cancellation, result animations, and reduced-motion behavior.
- Updated the download links to the current GitHub repository and documented setup and architecture.
